To keep momentum I pulled together a short mutual action plan (attached) and a recommended gating sequence for the MSA/DPA/order form so we can align procurement, legal, and finance expectations. High-level asks: two things we need from CureSys to finalize the timeline — (1) confirmation whether your legal team can review the DPA in parallel with the order form (they asked about sequencing), and (2) any procurement constraints (PO timing, finance lead times).

Folks — quick follow-up from the legal/procurement side. We can accept the parallel-review approach with one condition: the MSA must reach a stable redline state (no substantive term flips) before CureSys's legal provides final DPA approval. In practice that means:

1) Exchange MSA redlines by EOD Aug 11 (Avery/Redwood) — I can prepare a redline and attach here.
2) CureSys legal does a *review* of the DPA in parallel (Aug 12–18) — good to catch any cross-dependencies (data residency, breach notifications).
3) Order form sign can happen after commercial terms are locked; finance requires final order form + PO for vendor onboarding.

If CureSys legal cannot do review during Aug 12–18 because of the vacation noted, we should move DPA approval target to the week of Aug 23. I attached our suggested MSA redline draft for speed.
